audit_limit: The audit independently reconstructs candidate membership, greedy/gold joins, top-50 recalls, language/macro reductions, raw timing medians, the complete config grid and tune-only selection. Full retained mass is bounded and joined to its top-50 subset, but cannot be independently recomputed without all vocabulary probabilities or checkpoints. The frozen worker checks exact candidate-score parity and parameter immutability; this audit binds those source/measurement records without reloading model bodies or rerunning inference.
